data.title: Thousands and Zero Heroes
data.description: Learn to read four-digit numbers with zero placeholders using base-ten blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones carefully.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Remember to check the tens place! If there are no tens, what goes in that spot?

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the large cube thousands first, then the flats, and check the tens and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at how many hundreds and tens are on the mat.
